title: Node CI 3.3 transport documents
$comment: Structural transport validation is necessary, not sufficient. Installed fixed-kernel, attested-source, authenticated-platform, resource-budget and original-host live Gate readers remain mandatory.

InheritedNodeObject.$comment: The fixed existing Node2 byte-kernel validators enforce all subobject members, process/environment/coverage/output semantics and physical limits; this transport schema does not grant authority to an arbitrary object.
